purpose: Machine-visible receipt schema for HDI-15 (behavioural reuse evidence) and #323 section 4 (direct search-geometry measurement). No developmental claim is admissible without a receipt conforming to this schema. Prevents cached methods from impersonating development.

required_fields.arm: one of ORACLE_HISTORY / RESET / OCM_CONTINUED / SHUFFLED_HISTORY / knockout carrier ids
required_fields.m_star_digest: sha256 of the eventual successful method/operator/solution, with its identity class

m_star_in_history.rule: MUST be computed by the purity checker (normalized-text + digest), not asserted by the lane; if m_star_in_history is true the run CANNOT evidence development — it is reuse (classify as SOLUTION_EPISODIC per QUERY_ECOLOGY_AMENDMENT_V1)
m_star_in_history.cannot_check_rule: unresolvable history bytes emit CANNOT_CHECK with reason; the receipt is inadmissible for developmental claims until resolved

recorded_before_solution_discovery.eventual_success_rank: int >= 1; proposal rank of the eventual successful method at search start
recorded_before_solution_discovery.proposal_surprisal_bits: -log2 P(m* | arm proposal distribution) at search start
recorded_before_solution_discovery.proposal_entropy_bits: mean proposal entropy over the search
recorded_before_solution_discovery.decomposition_structure_digest: sha256 of the subgoal/decomposition DAG actually used
recorded_before_solution_discovery.information_queries: count + cost of external hints/evidence consumed
recorded_before_solution_discovery.retrieval_attempts: int, with successful_mappings int (HDI-15: history altered search = retrieval attempted AND used)

delta_receipt.rank_delta: rank_H(t+1)(m*) - rank_H(t)(m*) recorded per world; developmental direction is negative
delta_receipt.developmental_admissible: true iff rank_delta < 0 OR surprisal_delta_bits < 0 at the frozen threshold AND m_star_in_history == false AND cost-complete (HDI-14)

cost_ledger.rule: charged to BOTH arms, compute-matched (HDI-14); a missing family emits CANNOT_CHECK, never 0

invariants: fields under recorded_before_solution_discovery MUST be captured by instrumentation that runs before the solution is found; a post-hoc reconstruction emits RECONSTRUCTED=true and is inadmissible for HDI-15
every checker on this schema has a hostile positive control (planted leak fires) and a clean no-alarm control (clean run silent) — both retained in the run receipts
shuffle-equal-n null attaches to any adaptive-vs-fixed comparison derived from these receipts
CANNOT_CHECK stays distinct from PASS everywhere (HC-4)
